verdict.rationale: Rootly documents private status pages for communicating service health to internal stakeholders, and workflow automation in which 'stakeholders updated' runs as part of response. Status-page incident events are also exposed via the API and a public JSON endpoint, so stakeholders can follow structured updates without joining the incident channel. However, the pack never documents a subscription mechanism (email/SMS/RSS subscribe to updates) for internal audiences. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription to incident updates, detail on structured update templates for internal audiences, independent or hands-on corroboration.
